# sentry_project_data_scrubbing (Resource)

The server-side data scrubbing settings of a project: the scrubbers, and the sensitive and safe field lists. Every project has them, so creating this resource takes them over. Organization-wide settings (`sentry_organization_data_scrubbing`) apply on top. Destroying this resource only stops managing the settings: they stay as they are, since resetting them could switch scrubbing off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sentry_project_data_scrubbing" "api" {
  project_id = sentry_project.api.id

  data_scrubber          = true
  data_scrubber_defaults = true
  scrub_ip_addresses     = true

  # Never scrub these, even if they look sensitive.
  safe_fields = ["request_id", "build_number"]

  # Scrub these on top of Sentry's defaults.
  sensitive_fields = ["session_token", "internal_account_ref"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project, e.g. `sentry_project.example.id`.

### Optional

- `data_scrubber` (Boolean) Whether server-side data scrubbing is on for the project. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.
- `data_scrubber_defaults` (Boolean) Whether Sentry's default scrubbers, for things like passwords and credit card numbers, apply. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.
- `safe_fields` (Set of String) Field names the scrubbers leave alone. An empty set clears the list. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.
- `scrub_ip_addresses` (Boolean) Whether client IP addresses are kept out of stored events. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.
- `sensitive_fields` (Set of String) Additional field names to scrub. An empty set clears the list. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `project_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by project slug or ID.
terraform import sentry_project_data_scrubbing.api api
```
